shared.zh: 坡度：等高线和指向变亮最快方向的箭头
shared.en: slope: contours, and arrows pointing where it brightens fastest

about.zh: 剖面：一行像素的亮度曲线
about.en: profile: the brightness along one row of pixels

about.zh: 频谱：各频率分量的强度
about.en: spectrum: the strength of each frequency

shared.zh: 黑底上的几个亮点：[x, y, 亮度] 各一个
shared.en: a few bright dots on black: one for each [x, y, brightness]

shared.zh: 一条从左上到右下的对角线
shared.en: a diagonal line from the top left to the bottom right

about.zh: 左右两半一暗一亮的台阶
about.en: a step: left half one shade, right half another

about.zh: 上下两半一暗一亮的台阶
about.en: a step: top half one shade, bottom half another

about.zh: 从左到右由黑变白的斜坡
about.en: a ramp from black on the left to white on the right

about.zh: 从上到下由黑变白的斜坡
about.en: a ramp from black at the top to white at the bottom

shared.zh: 按格子坐标变化的平滑渐变：c + x·dx + y·dy
shared.en: a smooth gradient over the cells: c + x·dx + y·dy

about.zh: 一条竖线：一列亮，其余暗
about.en: a vertical line: one column bright, the rest dark

shared.zh: 一个矩形：左上角 (x0, y0)，宽 w、高 h
shared.en: a rectangle: top left (x0, y0), w wide and h high

shared.zh: 几个矩形：[x0, y0, 宽, 高] 各一个
shared.en: a few rectangles: one for each [x0, y0, width, height]

about.zh: 一个圆盘：圆心 (cx, cy)，半径 r
about.en: a disc: centre (cx, cy), radius r

about.zh: 几个圆盘：[cx, cy, r] 各一个
about.en: a few discs: one for each [cx, cy, r]
a checkerboard, its squares cell wide

shared.zh: 条纹：period 格一个周期，默认竖条（axis: y 是横条）
shared.en: stripes, one cycle every period cells: upright, or across with axis y

about.en: a corner: the bottom right bright

shared.zh: 斑点：每格 base + amp × 一个随机数，种子定下是哪一张
shared.en: speckles: base + amp × a random number a cell, the seed saying which

shared.zh: 两种亮度的颗粒：每格按它在不在形状里（圆 disc、右边 rightOf、斜纹 stripes）随机取亮或暗，各带一点抖动
shared.en: two shades with grain: each cell bright or dark at random by whether it is in a shape (a disc, right of a column, slanted stripes), each with a little jitter

about.zh: 圆：cx, cy, 半径的平方
about.en: a disc: cx, cy, the radius squared

shared.zh: 斜纹：(x + y) 除以 period 的余数小于 width
shared.en: slanted stripes: (x + y) mod period under width

shared.zh: 随机纹理：每格一个随机亮度，种子定下是哪一张
shared.en: a random texture: a random brightness a cell, the seed saying which

shared.zh: 斑马板：圆心 (cx, cy) 起越往外越密的同心圆，0.5 ± A
shared.en: a zone plate: rings from (cx, cy) getting denser outwards, 0.5 ± A

shared.zh: 布纹：period 格一个周期、朝 angle 度方向的斜条纹
shared.en: fabric: slanted stripes, one cycle every period cells, running at angle degrees

shared.zh: 一个字母（或照样画的几行），可以挪开、放大
shared.en: a letter (or rows drawn the same way), moved and scaled

shared.zh: 一行数（一个点、一条线、一个向量……）
shared.en: a row of numbers (a point, a line, a vector …)

about.zh: 一个柔和的斑点，中心 (x, y)
about.en: a soft blob centred on (x, y)

shared.zh: 一个 4 × 4 的图案（一个图块），亮度 hi
shared.en: a 4 × 4 pattern (one patch) at brightness hi

shared.zh: 频率半径：每格离频谱中心（频率 (0, 0)）多远
shared.en: the frequency radius: how far each cell is from the spectrum’s centre, frequency (0, 0)

shared.zh: 一张图每格加上 by（减 0.5 就是网络常用的居中）
shared.en: a picture with by added to every cell (less 0.5 centres it, as networks like)

shared.zh: 一张 16 × 16 的图缩放成 size × size（取最近的格子）
shared.en: a 16 × 16 picture scaled to size × size (nearest cell)

shared.zh: 一张图四周涂黑 width 格宽的边
shared.en: a picture with a black margin width cells wide

shared.zh: 一张图加上随机噪声（三个随机数之和，种子定下是哪一份）
shared.en: a picture with random noise added (a sum of three random numbers, the seed saying which)

shared.zh: 一张图的高斯模糊（σ，复制边缘；σ = 0 是原图）
shared.en: a picture under a Gaussian blur (σ, the edge replicated; σ = 0 is the picture itself)

shared.zh: 印刷品翻拍出的网纹：一张图叠上一道频率 (fx, fy) 的条纹
shared.en: a printed picture photographed with its screen: a picture with a grating of frequency (fx, fy) on it

shared.zh: 一张图（或几张）进，按一条规则算出的图出
shared.en: a picture (or a few) in, the picture a rule makes of them out

shared.zh: 输出怎样由测试的图算出（按关卡输入的顺序）
shared.en: how the output comes from the test’s pictures (in the order of the level’s inputs)

shared.zh: 每组测试都一样的输入（比如频率半径）
shared.en: inputs every test shares (the frequency radius, say)

about.zh: 有几个输入时，每个输入的图
about.en: the picture of each input, when there are several

shared.zh: 灰蒙蒙的照片：亮度挤进 0.25 … 0.75，期望是原来的照片
shared.en: a washed-out photo, its brightness squeezed into 0.25 … 0.75; the photo as it was is expected

shared.zh: 闯入者：现场比空场多一个 4×4 的东西，光照不均；期望是它的掩膜
shared.en: an intruder: the scene has one 4×4 thing more than the empty scene, lit unevenly; its mask is expected

shared.zh: 闯入者的外圈：任意形状的闯入者站在花砖地面上；期望是它挨着地面的那一圈格子（图外算地面）
shared.en: an intruder’s outer ring: an intruder of any shape on a tiled floor; the ring of its cells touching the floor is expected (outside the picture counts as floor)

about.zh: 一个矩形：x0, y0, 宽, 高
about.en: a rectangle: x0, y0, width, height
the intruder: a union of rectangles

shared.zh: 质检台：标准件的照片和传送带上的实物，实物上有凹坑（偏暗）和划痕（偏亮），灯可能老了；期望是缺陷的掩膜
shared.en: the inspection station: a photo of the reference and the part on the belt, with dents (darker) and scratches (brighter), under a lamp that may have aged; the defects’ mask is expected

about.zh: 灯还剩原来亮度的几成
about.en: what the lamp has left of its brightness

shared.zh: 带噪声的台阶（左暗右亮）：期望是真正的台阶处为 1
shared.en: a noisy step, dark on the left and bright on the right: 1 where the real step is, expected

shared.zh: 扫描仪：深色桌面上的一张纸，纸上几行字，可能有噪声，纸可能超出扫描范围
shared.en: the scanner: a sheet of paper on a dark desk, a few lines of text, maybe noise, the paper maybe running off the scan

shared.zh: 期望：去掉颗粒的扫描件（clean）、Sobel 平方和大于 0.04 处（edges）、纸的边（paper）
shared.en: expected: the scan without its grain (clean), where Sobel’s sum of squares is over 0.04 (edges), the paper’s edges (paper)

about.en: a line of text: x, y, length

shared.zh: 一条 32 个点的波形：平均亮度 c 加几道波；期望是频率 k 那道波的振幅（没有就是 0）
shared.en: a waveform of 32 points, an average c plus a few waves; the amplitude of the wave of frequency k (0 if there is none) is expected

about.en: how many degrees it is shifted

shared.zh: 蒙着细颗粒的照片（32 × 32，低于 10 周的成分都去掉的噪声）；期望是照片轻轻模糊（σ = 1，复制边缘）
shared.en: a photo under fine grain (32 × 32, noise with everything below 10 cycles removed); the photo gently blurred (σ = 1, the edge replicated) is expected

shared.zh: 一块表面：它的法线和反射率；期望是灯光下的样子（朗伯着色，可以再加一盏半亮的补光）
shared.en: a surface, its normals and its reflectance; how it looks under the lamp (Lambert shading, maybe with a half-strength fill light) is expected

about.zh: 鼓包：cx, cy, 半径, 高
about.en: a bump: cx, cy, radius, height

about.zh: 坑：cx, cy, 半径, 深
about.en: a dent: cx, cy, radius, depth
a ridge: y0, half width, height

about.zh: 斜面：x 方向和 y 方向的坡度
about.en: a slope: its gradient across and down

shared.zh: 沟：x0, y0, x1, y1, 半宽, 深
shared.en: a groove: x0, y0, x1, y1, half width, depth
a saddle bend: k·((x − 7.5)² − (y − 7.5)²)

shared.zh: 高度场：几项相加（每项一个键），空表是平板
shared.en: a height field: terms added up (one key each); none is a flat sheet

shared.zh: 一条光谱和三种感光元件的灵敏度曲线；期望是 R、G、B 三个读数
shared.en: a spectrum and the sensitivity curves of three sensors; the R, G and B readings are expected

shared.zh: 十个波段（400–700 nm，每段 30 nm）的强度
shared.en: the strength in ten bands (400–700 nm, 30 nm each)

shared.zh: 两块布（日光下一样）和一盏灯；期望是相机读出的两块布 R、G、B 之差
shared.en: two cloths that match in daylight, and a lamp; what the camera reads of their R, G and B differences is expected

shared.zh: 照片 = 油漆 × 光照，光照另给；期望是油漆本来的颜色
shared.en: a photo = paint × light, the light given too; the paint itself is expected

shared.zh: 一个彩色场景（R、G、B 三张图），光照不均；期望是红色东西的掩膜（R 占三者之和一半以上）
shared.en: a coloured scene (R, G, B), lit unevenly; the mask of what is red (R over half of the three’s sum) is expected

shared.zh: 暖黄的灯下拍的彩色场景，亮度为 strength；期望是每个通道除以它自己的最大值
shared.en: a coloured scene under a warm yellow lamp at brightness strength; each channel divided by its own maximum is expected

shared.zh: 同一个物体换了灯光：亮度 × gain + offset；期望是它的边（梯度大于最大值一半的地方）
shared.en: one object under other light, brightness × gain + offset; its edges (where the gradient is over half its maximum) are expected

shared.zh: 光度立体：一张有污渍的金属板，三盏已知方向的灯各拍一张；期望是它朝右倾的地方、它的反射率，或它陡的地方
shared.en: photometric stereo: a stained metal sheet photographed under three lamps of known direction; where it leans right, its reflectance, or where it is steep, is expected

shared.zh: 倾斜的门槛（lean：nx / nz；steep：坡度）
shared.en: the threshold of the tilt (lean: nx / nz; steep: the slope)

shared.zh: 一个数进、一个数出：期望是 scale·x + offset
shared.en: a number in, a number out: scale·x + offset expected

shared.zh: 一个字母化成两个数：斜笔画多少、弯笔画多少；期望 X 是 1，O 是 0
shared.en: a letter as two numbers, how much diagonal stroke and how much curved; 1 for an X, 0 for an O expected

shared.zh: 暗底上的亮块（有一点噪声）；期望是周围 7×7 全亮的格子
shared.en: bright blocks on a dark ground with a little noise; the cells whose whole 7×7 is bright expected

shared.zh: 几个亮点，从原位挪开一点；期望是原位的点做 2×2 最大池化
shared.en: a few bright dots, moved a little from home; the 2×2 max pool of the dots at home expected

shared.zh: 一个 X 或 O，位置、墨色、噪点各不同；期望 X 是 1，O 是 0
shared.en: an X or an O at some place, ink and noise; 1 for an X, 0 for an O expected

about.zh: 噪点的种子，0 是没有噪点

shared.zh: 一张彩色图的三个通道（各减 0.5）；期望是一种颜色对比（红对绿，或蓝对黄）的边
shared.en: a colour picture’s three channels (each less 0.5); the edges of one colour contrast (red against green, or blue against yellow) expected

shared.zh: 街景的三个通道：红灯、阴影里的红车、白色路灯、绿灯；期望是红灯的掩膜
shared.en: a street in three channels, with red lights, red cars in shade, white lamps and green lights; the red lights’ mask expected

shared.zh: 一张彩色图；期望是模糊后的两种通道组合：R − G 和 R + G − 2B
shared.en: a colour picture; two mixes of its blurred channels expected: R − G and R + G − 2B

shared.zh: 三类的分数；期望是 softmax 给的三个概率
shared.en: the scores of three classes; the three probabilities softmax gives expected

shared.zh: 分拣带上的零件：X、O 或 +，位置、墨色、噪点各不同；期望是它属于哪一类
shared.en: a part on the sorting belt, an X, an O or a +, at some place, ink and noise; which class it is expected

shared.zh: 一张图上几个图案，一对对角上的同一个图案被擦掉了几格；期望是补好的图
shared.en: a few patterns on a picture, a pair across the diagonal the same, one copy with a few pixels erased; the picture mended expected

shared.zh: 图案的一格画成几格（2：8 × 8 的图案）
shared.en: how many cells a pattern pixel takes (2: 8 × 8 patterns)

about.en: the row and column of its patch

shared.zh: 两张这样的图，孪生图案的位置各不相同；期望是补好的两张图
shared.en: two such pictures, their twins placed differently; both mended expected

shared.zh: 灰底上一块亮、一块暗，另给每格的图块编号；按阅读顺序亮块在前就整张图是 1
shared.en: one bright and one dark patch on grey, with each cell’s patch number given; 1 all over when the bright one comes first in reading order

shared.zh: 几个图案，各有各的亮度；期望是每个图块都变成最亮的那个图案
shared.en: a few patterns, each at its own brightness; every patch turned into the brightest pattern expected

shared.zh: 要找的照片和三张候选，其中一张是同一张照片（挪了、调了色或加了噪声）；期望是它那一路为 1
shared.en: a photo to find and three candidates, one of them the same photo shifted, recoloured or noisy; 1 on its line expected

shared.zh: 两张照片；期望是它们是不是同一张（挪了、调了色或加了噪声也算）
shared.en: two photos; whether they are the same one (even shifted, recoloured or noisy) expected

shared.zh: 一张有几个平滑鼓包的响应图；期望是它的峰：比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 above 的格子
shared.en: a response map with smooth bumps; its peaks expected: cells no smaller than their 3×3 neighbours and above `above`

shared.zh: 每格一个关键点，三张图是它到三个候选的距离；期望是距离比检验配上的候选（1–3，没配上是 0）
shared.en: each cell a keypoint, three maps its distances to three candidates; the candidate the ratio test accepts (1–3, else 0) expected

about.zh: 第二近紧跟在后的格子
about.en: the cells where the second nearest is close behind

shared.zh: 关键点的窗口和三个候选：真搭档是同一块纹理调亮了 0.3，另两个是同样亮的平淡纹理；期望是搭档的编号
shared.en: a keypoint’s window and three candidates, its partner the same texture brightened by 0.3, the others flat textures as bright; the partner’s number expected

shared.zh: 暗路面上的车道线和几个亮斑；期望是投票累加器（× 1/8）里的峰
shared.en: lanes on a dark road with a few bright specks; the peaks of the vote accumulator (× 1/8) expected

about.zh: 一条线经过的两点：x1, y1, x2, y2
about.en: two points on a line: x1, y1, x2, y2

shared.zh: 一条线和随机的杂点；期望是那条真线
shared.en: a line among random specks; the true line expected

shared.zh: 一个小格：期望是梯度幅值按方向（→ ↑ ← ↓）分到四个数，各除以格数
shared.en: one cell: its gradient magnitude shared out to four directions (→ ↑ ← ↓), each divided by the cells, expected

shared.zh: 书的照片、清楚的封面和单应 H；期望是封面贴回照片上
shared.en: a photo of the book, the crisp cover and the homography H; the cover pasted back onto the photo expected

about.zh: 书的四个角在照片里的位置
about.en: where the book’s four corners are in the photo

shared.zh: 书的照片、封面和匹配的点对（有噪声，夹着错配）；期望是用对的点对解出的单应贴回封面
shared.en: a photo of the book, the cover and matched pairs (noisy, with wrong ones among them); the cover pasted back by the homography of the right pairs expected

shared.zh: 左右两台相机拍的一对图：远墙前有几层有纹理的东西；期望是视差图
shared.en: a pair from a left and a right camera, textured layers before a far wall; the disparity map expected

shared.zh: 它占的矩形：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
shared.en: the rectangle it fills: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 远墙前面的几层，从后往前
about.en: the layers before the far wall, back to front

shared.zh: 一张视差图（远墙视差 1）；期望是距离 f·b ÷ 视差。给了 f、b 时它们也是输入，否则 f·b = 3
shared.en: a disparity map (the far wall at 1); the distance f·b ÷ disparity expected, f and b inputs too when given, else f·b = 3

shared.zh: 一对相机的基础矩阵 F（按列）和左图的点 (x, y)；期望是右图里的极线 F·p
shared.en: a camera pair’s fundamental matrix F (by columns) and a left point (x, y); the epipolar line F·p in the right image expected

shared.zh: 同样的 F、左图的点和右图的点 q；期望是 q 在不在极线上（|q·l′| < 0.05）
shared.en: the same F, a left point and a right point q; whether q is on the epipolar line (|q·l′| < 0.05) expected

shared.zh: 同样的 F 的三列（按给的顺序）和 (0, 0, 1)；期望是极点 e′
shared.en: the same F’s three columns (in the order given) and (0, 0, 1); the epipole e′ expected

shared.zh: 扫地机器人的双目：远墙、没有纹理的地面、障碍物，另给地面以上的区域；期望是区域里的距离，或 1.2 米内要停的地方
shared.en: a robot vacuum’s stereo pair, a far wall, a textureless floor and obstacles, with the region above the floor given; the distance in the region, or where to stop within 1.2 m, expected

shared.zh: 同样的房间，已经算好的距离（地面没有纹理，那里的距离是乱的）；期望是 1.2 米内要停的地方
shared.en: the same room as distances already found (the floor has no texture, so its distances are anything); where to stop within 1.2 m expected

about.zh: 地面上乱的距离的种子
about.en: the seed of the floor’s stray distances

shared.zh: 两个斑点和走到哪 t；期望是潜空间里两点之间 t 处的斑点
shared.en: two blobs and how far t; the blob at t between them in latent space expected

about.zh: 带噪声的斑点；期望是干净的斑点
about.en: a noisy blob; the clean blob expected

shared.zh: 噪声 ε（两个数）；期望是潜码 μ + σ·ε 画出的斑点。given：μ 和 σ 也是输入
shared.en: noise ε (two numbers); the blob the latent code μ + σ·ε draws expected (given: μ and σ are inputs too)

shared.zh: 噪声 ε 和画哪边 c（0 左，1 右），另给左右两个中心和 σ；期望是那一边 μ + σ·ε 画出的斑点
shared.en: noise ε and which side c (0 left, 1 right), with the two centres and σ given; the blob μ + σ·ε draws on that side expected

shared.zh: 一个字母 x₀、一张高斯噪声 ε 和剩下多少 ᾱ；期望是一步加到的 x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε
shared.en: a letter x₀, Gaussian noise ε and how much is left, ᾱ; x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε, noised in one step, expected

shared.zh: 同一个字母加两次噪声：两张噪声、两个 ᾱ；期望是加完两次的图
shared.en: one letter noised twice, two noises and two ᾱ; the picture after both expected

shared.zh: 加了噪的 x_t、当初加的噪声 ε 和 ᾱ；期望是原来的字母 x₀
shared.en: the noisy x_t, the noise ε that was added and ᾱ; the letter x₀ as it was expected

shared.zh: 一张旧照片：一个字母在 ᾱ 下加了噪，噪声不知道；期望是还原的照片和字的笔画
shared.en: an old photo, a letter noised at ᾱ with the noise unknown; the restored photo and the letter’s strokes expected

shared.zh: 一张 16 × 16 的图和它 2 × 2 最大池化后的 8 × 8；期望是反池化：每个值放回它原来的那一格，其余为 0
shared.en: a 16 × 16 picture and its 8 × 8 after 2 × 2 max pooling; the unpooling expected: each value back in its own cell, the rest 0

shared.zh: 一张图和一个分界 m；期望是 k 均值的一步给出的新分界（step），或走三步后按分界分出的掩膜（segment）
shared.en: a picture and a boundary m; the new boundary one step of k-means gives (step), or the mask split at the boundary after three steps (segment), expected

shared.zh: 显微镜下的细胞：亮的细胞、暗一些的底、颗粒，挨着的细胞之间留一格缝；期望是细胞的掩膜
shared.en: cells under a microscope, bright on a darker ground, with grain and one-pixel gaps between touching cells; the cells’ mask expected

shared.zh: 细胞：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
shared.en: a cell: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

shared.zh: 两个框的掩膜；期望是交并比（iou），或交并比是否大于 0.5（good）
shared.en: two boxes’ masks; their intersection over union (iou), or whether it is over 0.5 (good), expected

shared.zh: 一个框：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
shared.en: a box: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

shared.zh: 按分数排好的检测对错、名次 1 … 16 和标注数 G；期望是 AP
shared.en: the detections right or wrong in score order, the ranks 1 … 16 and the number labelled G; the AP expected

shared.zh: 按分数排好的 16 个检测，对 1 错 0
shared.en: the 16 detections in score order, right 1 and wrong 0

shared.zh: 两类各自的排名表和标注数，另给名次；期望是两类 AP 的平均（mAP）
shared.en: two classes’ ranked lists and numbers labelled, with the ranks; the mean of their APs (mAP) expected

shared.zh: 一排锚框 (cx, cy, w, h) 和网络给的修正 (tx, ty, tw, th)；期望是修正后的框
shared.en: a row of anchor boxes (cx, cy, w, h) and the network’s corrections (tx, ty, tw, th); the corrected boxes expected

shared.zh: 16 × 16 的货架上的小记号：X 是要找的盒子，O 不要；期望是每个 X 的中心
shared.en: small marks on a 16 × 16 shelf, X for the boxes to find and O for the rest; each X’s centre expected

shared.zh: 24 × 24 的货架，小号和大号的记号，可能有颗粒、可能有点糊；期望是小号 X 的中心（small），或连大号 X 也标出（both，大号标成一个 2 × 2 块）
shared.en: a 24 × 24 shelf with small and large marks, maybe grainy, maybe a little blurred; the small Xs’ centres (small), or the large ones too, each a 2 × 2 block (both), expected

shared.zh: 先模糊（高斯的 σ，复制边缘）
shared.en: a blur first (the Gaussian’s σ, the edge replicated)

shared.zh: 几只狗，每只是一团亮的斑；期望是每只狗的中心
shared.en: a few dogs, each a solid bright blob; each dog’s centre expected

shared.zh: 一条有车的街和一个线性分类器的权重（可以另给车的掩膜）；期望是每格的贡献、遮挡图、落在车上的分数比例、热图落在车上的比例，或体检的热图和判定
shared.en: a street with a car and a linear classifier’s weights (and the car’s mask, maybe); each cell’s contribution, the occlusion map, the share of the score on the car, the share of the heat map on it, or the check-up’s heat map and verdict, expected

shared.zh: 遮挡用的块：亮度 v，r × r（默认黑的 3 × 3）
shared.en: the block covering: brightness v, r × r (black 3 × 3 at first)

about.en: the column of the car’s left side
the column of the house’s left side

shared.zh: 一条街、ViT 类别 token 的查询和车所在的图块；期望是注意力落在车上的比例
shared.en: a street, a ViT class token’s query and the patches with the car; the share of attention on the car expected

about.zh: 车所在的图块 [列, 行]
about.en: the patches with the car, [column, row]

shared.zh: 整张图挪 (dx, dy) 格，图外补 0（或照 border 补）
shared.en: the whole picture moved by (dx, dy), padded with 0 (or as border says)

about.zh: 底片：每格变成 1 − 自己
about.en: the negative: every cell becomes 1 − itself

shared.zh: 邻居的加权和（互相关）：核按行写出，中心对着这一格
shared.en: a weighted sum of the neighbours (cross-correlation): the kernel row by row, its centre on the cell

shared.zh: 用核盖印章（卷积）：每个像素按核的样子盖一个，挪到位、乘上权重再相加
shared.en: stamping with a kernel (convolution): every pixel presses the kernel’s shape, moved into place, weighted and added up

about.en: a Gaussian blur: σ, and the kernel’s radius

shared.zh: 锐化：原图 + amount ×（原图 − σ 的高斯模糊）
shared.en: sharpening: the picture + amount × (the picture − its Gaussian blur of σ)

about.zh: 横向差分：右边邻居 − 自己
about.en: the difference across: right neighbour − itself

about.zh: 两种边都要：|右边邻居 − 自己|
about.en: both kinds of edge: |right neighbour − itself|

shared.zh: 步幅 2 的卷积层：按核做互相关，再隔点取样
shared.en: a convolution layer of stride 2: cross-correlate with the kernel, then keep every other pixel

shared.zh: 向 3×3 平均靠：a + amount ×（平均 − a）；amount 为负是锐化
shared.en: a pull towards the 3×3 mean: a + amount × (mean − a); a negative amount sharpens

shared.zh: 图块 a 向 a、b 两块提问：两块按 softmax(4 × 平均(a × 这一块)) 加权平均
shared.en: patch a asks patches a and b: the two averaged with the weights softmax(4 × average(a × each))

shared.zh: 角点：Harris 响应大于 threshold 的地方
shared.en: corners: where the Harris response is over threshold

shared.zh: 一个角一个点：Harris 响应乘 gain 后的峰（比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 above）
shared.en: one point a corner: the peaks of the Harris response times gain (no smaller than the 3×3 neighbours, and above `above`)

shared.zh: 放大一倍：补零放大，再按核做互相关（转置卷积）
shared.en: twice the size: zero-upsampled, then cross-correlated with the kernel (a transposed convolution)

about.zh: 两个三维向量的叉积 a × b
about.en: the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors

shared.zh: 两条线的交点：过 p、q 的线和过 r、s 的线（齐次坐标）
shared.en: where two lines meet: the line through p and q and the line through r and s (homogeneous coordinates)

shared.zh: 梯度幅值：√(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)
shared.en: the gradient magnitude: √(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)

shared.zh: 频域低通：半径 R 以内的频率留下（disk 一刀切，gauss 平滑落下）
shared.en: a low-pass in frequency: what is within radius R stays (disk cuts sharply, gauss falls smoothly)

shared.zh: 清晰度：频谱里离中心超过 beyond 的部分的平均
shared.en: sharpness: the mean of the spectrum beyond radius `beyond` from its centre

shared.zh: 去网纹：频谱里半径 radius 以外、比 threshold 亮的格子去掉，其余照旧
shared.en: descreening: the spectrum’s cells beyond `radius` brighter than `threshold` removed, the rest kept

shared.zh: 混合图像：A 的低频 + B 的高频（半径 R 的高斯）
shared.en: a hybrid image: the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B (a Gaussian of radius R)

shared.zh: 缩小：σ 的高斯模糊一次（复制边缘），再隔点取样 halvings 次
shared.en: shrinking: one Gaussian blur of σ (the edge replicated), then every other pixel kept, halvings times

shared.zh: 图像金字塔：模糊一点（σ = 1，复制边缘）再减半，做 levels 次
shared.en: an image pyramid: blur a little (σ = 1, the edge replicated) and halve, levels times

about.en: unchanged: the output is the input
the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
a cost of at most max

about.zh: 元件不超过 max 个

shared.zh: 频域的元件（频域低通、频域相乘）一共不超过 max 个
shared.en: at most max frequency-domain parts (frequency low-pass, multiply in frequency) in all

shared.zh: 最深的一条路上至少 min 个可训练的层
shared.en: at least min trainable layers on the deepest path

shared.zh: 图像要经过编码器，瓶颈不超过 max 个数
shared.en: the picture passes through the encoder, a bottleneck of at most max numbers

shared.zh: 暗箱：旋钮 Z（孔板到箭头）、s（屏幕到箭头）、D（孔径）；算出像高 height、模糊 blur、亮度 light
shared.en: the camera obscura: knobs Z (plate from the arrow), s (screen from the arrow), D (the hole); computes the image height, blur and light

shared.zh: 核速判：看输入和输出，限时选出是哪个 3×3 核；旋钮 untimed（不限时）；一局结束后 final 是答对的轮数
shared.en: the kernel sprint: from an input and its output, pick the 3×3 kernel against the clock; knob untimed; once a run ends, final is how many rounds were right

shared.zh: 核按 3×3 核元件的读法：权重是 cells ÷ div
shared.en: kernels as the 3×3 kernel part reads them: the weights are cells ÷ div

shared.zh: 第 n 轮（从 0 数）的秒数：max(min, start − step·n)
shared.en: the seconds for round n (from 0): max(min, start − step·n)

shared.zh: 一道波：c + A·cos(2π·k·x/N + φ·π/4)，旋钮 c、A、k、phi；每一步把它调到和目标重合
shared.en: one wave, c + A·cos(2π·k·x/N + φ·π/4), knobs c, A, k, phi: each step lays it on the target

shared.zh: 叠加：频率 ks 各一道正弦波，振幅旋钮名为 k1、k2…，叠到目标上
shared.en: stacking waves: a sine wave for each frequency in ks, with amplitude knobs named k1, k2 …, stacked onto the target

shared.zh: 探针：曲线乘一道波再平均，读出一个频率；旋钮 j（探针频率）、m（读数乘以）、shift（输入错开）、pick（两个读数的合法：cos、sin、sum、mag）
shared.en: the probe: a curve times a wave, averaged, reads one frequency; knobs j (probe frequency), m (reading times), shift (input shift), pick (how two readings combine: cos, sin, sum, mag)

shared.zh: 可以错开的那道输入波（中线 0.5）
shared.en: the input wave that can be shifted (on a middle line of 0.5)

shared.zh: find：转频率找到它；read：读出振幅；blind：错开到读不到；combine：合两个读数
shared.en: find: turn the frequency to find it; read: read its amplitude; blind: shift it out of sight; combine: put two readings together

about.zh: 合读数时试的几个错开角度
about.en: the shifts a combination is tried at

about.zh: 这一步接受的全部答案，用逗号连起
about.en: every answer the step accepts, joined by commas

shared.zh: 采样台：连续的波变成一排点；每一步只开 k（冒名的频率）、M（采样点数）、K（采样前保留的最高频率）中的一个
shared.en: the sampling bench: a continuous wave turned into points; each step opens one of k (the impostor frequency), M (how many samples), K (the highest frequency kept before sampling)

shared.zh: 不滤就采时，频率 k 采 M 个点后折回到哪里：[k, M, 折回的频率]
shared.en: where a frequency k folds to when M points are sampled unfiltered: [k, M, the frequency it poses as]

shared.zh: 这一步能过的全部值，用逗号连起
shared.en: every value the step passes with, joined by commas

shared.zh: 什么时候停：多项式拟合几个带噪声的样本；旋钮 step（训练到第几个检查点）、lambda（第几个惩罚）；ratio 是新样本误差和它的最低值之比
shared.en: when to stop: a polynomial fitted to a few noisy samples; knobs step (the checkpoint trained to) and lambda (which penalty); ratio is the new-sample error over its lowest

shared.zh: 拉近与推开：没有标签，训练编码器让每张图的两个变形版本互相认出；旋钮 push；算出 worst（认对搭档的最低概率）、negative（负对平均 sim）
shared.en: pull close, push apart: with no labels, train an encoder so two altered views of each picture find each other; knob push; computes worst (the lowest chance of picking the partner) and negative (the mean sim of negative pairs)

shared.zh: 投票：边缘点给经过它的每条直线投票；旋钮 bin 选分箱大小；每个情形是一张图，matched 是前两个峰对上的线数
shared.en: voting: edge points vote for every line through them; knob bin picks the bin size; each case is a picture, and matched counts the lines the top two peaks hit

shared.zh: 共识：每轮随机抽两点连线、数支持它的点；旋钮 delta（门槛）和每个情形的 k（轮数）；每个情形是一种外点比例，算出几百次试验的成功率 rate 和超出预算的轮数 overBudget
shared.en: consensus: each round joins two random points and counts the support; knobs delta (the threshold) and k per case (the rounds); each case is an outlier ratio, with the success rate over hundreds of trials and overBudget, the rounds over budget

shared.zh: 一组能过的设定：门槛 δ 和每一种外点比例的轮数
shared.en: settings that pass: the threshold δ and the rounds for each outlier ratio

shared.zh: 四个角：在封面和照片上连出对应点（旋钮 pairs），解出单应，把封面贴回照片；算出点对数 pairs 和误差 error
shared.en: four corners: pair points on the cover and in the photo (knob pairs), solve the homography, paste the cover back; computes how many pairs and the error

shared.zh: 骗过鉴定员：两支笔的生成器对一个鉴定员，按旋钮 dSteps、gSteps、gRate 定的节奏轮流训练；算出 left、right（两堆各占多少）、accuracy、streak（其余目标连续达到的回合数）
shared.en: fooling the judge: a two-pen generator against a discriminator, trained in turns at the rhythm of knobs dSteps, gSteps, gRate; computes left, right (each cluster’s share), accuracy, and streak (turns in a row the other limits held)

shared.zh: 只在模型的这个量为真时显示
shared.en: shown only while this quantity of the model is true

about.en: sticks to the bottom on a phone

about.zh: 第一列窄，手机上也并排
about.en: a narrow first column, side by side on a phone too
each only as wide as it needs

shared.zh: 目标达到没有；分步的台子带「下一步」
shared.en: whether the goal holds; a stepped bench adds “next step”

about.zh: 目标的每一条和此刻的值
about.en: each limit of the goal and its value now
switch between the cases, each marked passed or not

shared.zh: 模型给出的 { lines, dots, legend }
shared.en: the model’s { lines, dots, legend }

about.zh: 曲线图：指向一处读出各条线的值
about.en: a line plot: point at a spot to read every line

about.zh: 几行像素，最暗是 0，最亮是 1
about.en: rows of pixels, darkest at 0 and lightest at 1

shared.zh: 一段字：写定的，或模型算出的
shared.en: a line of words: written, or computed by the model

shared.zh: 暗箱的侧视图：拖动孔板和屏幕（旋钮 Z、s）
shared.en: the camera obscura from the side: drag the plate and the screen (knobs Z, s)

shared.zh: 屏幕正面：像的大小、模糊和亮度，目标高度画成一条线
shared.en: the screen from the front: the image’s size, blur and brightness, with the goal height as a line

shared.zh: 边缘点和找到的线，旁边是 (θ, ρ) 累加器，可放大
shared.en: the edge points and the lines found, beside the (θ, ρ) accumulator, which zooms

shared.zh: 一次试验：点、抽中的两点、门槛色带和找到的直线
shared.en: one trial: the points, the two drawn, the threshold band and the line found

shared.zh: 每种外点比例一张卡：轮数旋钮和预算、成功率、每次试验（点一下看它）
shared.en: a card per outlier ratio: the rounds knob and budget, the success rate, each trial (tap one to see it)

shared.zh: 封面和照片：从一点拖到另一点（或先后点）连成一对（旋钮 pairs），贴回的封面画在照片上
shared.en: the cover and the photo: drag from a point to another (or tap both) to pair them (knob pairs); the pasted cover is drawn on the photo

about.zh: 已连的点对，可以逐对删除

shared.zh: 真实数据和生成样本的直方图、鉴定员 D(x)、两支笔的历史位置，随回合动起来
shared.en: the histograms of real and generated samples, the judge’s D(x) and the pens’ history, moving turn by turn

shared.zh: 嵌入平面：每个测验视图是单位圆上的一点，随训练滑动
shared.en: the embedding plane: each quiz view a point on the unit circle, gliding as it trains

shared.zh: 每个视图在其余视图里选搭档的概率表
shared.en: the table of each view’s chances of picking each other view as its partner

about.zh: 这一轮的输入和输出，带倒计时
about.en: this round’s input and output, with the clock

shared.zh: 四张核卡片，点一张（或按 1–4）作答
shared.en: four kernel cards: tap one (or press 1–4) to answer

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up building, not how many levels

about.zh: 第一次打开时的上电台词
about.en: the power-on lines on first opening

about.zh: 没有电路能搭出的元件

shared.zh: 几套托盘：每套是一串元件，按托盘上的先后排；关卡用其中一套，托盘上的元件在带来它或搭出它的那一关之后可用。不写时每关拿到见过的所有元件
shared.en: the trays: each a list of parts in the order it shows them; a level plays with one, and a part on it is usable after the level that brings it in or builds it. Without, every level holds every part it has met

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

about.zh: 一个元件出现后取代的元件
about.en: the parts a part supersedes once met

shared.zh: 每种画法在哪一关引入（像素一开始就有）
shared.en: the level each way of drawing a picture comes with (pixels from the start)

shared.zh: 没有测试的关解锁的元件，在这一关的测试图上试
shared.en: the level whose pictures a part from a level without tests is tried on

shared.zh: 在这一关的参考电路里试的元件
shared.en: parts tried inside a level’s own reference circuit

about.zh: 一块电路板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 试这个元件用的电路（参考电路里把它拆成了小元件时）
shared.en: the board a part is tried on (where the reference spells it out in smaller parts)

about.zh: 元件箱怎么试一个元件
about.en: how the parts box tries a part

shared.zh: 文案里可以照字面引用的名字（说的是别的东西）
shared.en: names a text may quote rather than link (they mean something else there)

shared.zh: 通过这一关时说的话（最后一个任务的点题）
shared.en: what passing the level says (its last task’s pass text)

shared.zh: 笔记插图的名字（trace-viewer/src/figures 登记的 id，检查时核对）
shared.en: the id of one of the notes’ figures (as trace-viewer/src/figures registers it, checked)

shared.zh: 引言：进关前读的几页，每页一段话和一张可选的图
shared.en: the intro: pages read before playing, each a paragraph and maybe a figure

shared.zh: 这一关（这个任务）用的托盘；游戏只有一套托盘时不用写
shared.en: the tray this level (task) plays with; a game of one tray need not say

shared.zh: 这一关自己就给出的设置选项（它要亲手用它搭出元件）；不能是元件
shared.en: setting options the level gives for its own play (it builds a part with one); never a part

shared.zh: 通关的电路成为一个元件：它的名字和说明
shared.en: the passing circuit becomes a part: its name and description

shared.zh: 新元件第一次出现时只放它一个也算一关：它的用法抽象在哪里
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only places it: what is abstract about its use

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 这个任务的名字，写在任务条上（一关只有一个任务时不显示）
shared.en: the task’s name on the strip of tasks (not shown when the level has one task)

shared.zh: 这个任务通过时说的话（最后一个任务用这一关的点题）
shared.en: what passing the task says (the last task says the level’s pass text)

shared.zh: 这一段搭出的能力：后面的任务马上能用，整关通过时解锁
shared.en: what this task builds: the tasks after it hold it at once, and passing the level unlocks it

shared.zh: 这一段亲手搭的东西：玩家已有也先收起
shared.en: what this task builds by hand: kept from a player who holds it already

about.en: start from the task before’s board

about.zh: 输入元件的说明，按输入名填写
about.en: descriptions of input parts, keyed by input name

shared.zh: 输入、输出、中间元件默认的画法
shared.en: how the inputs, the outputs and the parts between are drawn at first

shared.zh: 一格差多少算对（tolerance），最多几格不对（mismatches）
shared.en: how far a cell may be off (tolerance), how many cells may be wrong (mismatches)

about.en: how far one training step goes

shared.zh: 能选的学习率（选了就不再回退步长）
shared.en: the learning rates to choose from (a step is then taken as it is)

about.zh: 一块电路板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: false：不拿来训练，只用来检查训练（新样本）
shared.en: false: not trained on, only checking the training (a new sample)

about.en: the black box on the bench

shared.zh: 起始值（阶段的 start 优先）
shared.en: the starting value (a stage’s start comes first)

shared.zh: 在图上拖动来设，不另画控件
shared.en: set by dragging on a picture, no control of its own

about.zh: 一列东西（在图上点出的点对）
about.en: a list of things (pairs picked on a picture)

about.zh: 这一步能动的旋钮（不写：全部）
about.en: the knobs this step opens (none given: all)

about.zh: 模型可以按这个名字换按钮上的字
about.en: the name the model may relabel the button by
can be pressed while a run goes on

shared.zh: 目标怎样判：live 随旋钮实时判（默认）；submit 只在玩家按「检查」时判，在那之前目标的读数和画面里的结果都不显示，玩家要先想好再试
